paragraphs: So Yuchasin cites from the first chapter of Sanhedrin; the text Hyman uses there, at 7a, reads Abaye Kashisha.[^1]

notes.text: The actual whole Davidson Sanhedrin 7a paragraph writes Abaye Kashisha. Hyman’s Abba heading and Yuchasin report remain distinct and attributed; Yuchasin was not freshly collated and no alias or correction history is admitted.
